rules.title: Expo tooling
rules.text: Use Expo tooling and config plugins instead of editing native projects by hand.

rules.title: Virtualized lists
rules.text: Use FlatList or FlashList for long lists, never map inside ScrollView.

rules.title: Test on both platforms
rules.text: Verify changes on both iOS and Android and keep platform branches small.

rules.title: Safe areas
rules.text: Respect safe areas and keyboard avoidance on every screen.
